about: Shared boarddd/impedance cases (generated by make_cases.mjs; lengths in mm). See docs/impedance.md.

polar.about: Polar Instruments Si9000 (BEM field solver), published microstrip cases: IPC 1999 paper, https://www.polarinstruments.com/support/cits/IPC1999.pdf

hfss.about: Ansys HFSS, 1 GHz full-wave with loss, as published in Ttl/js_2d_fields tests/test_vs_ref.js (loss raises Z about 0.5-1 % over a quasi-static answer)

cohn.about: Cohn 1954/1955 exact conformal maps (t = 0), evaluated with scipy.special.ellipk (an independent elliptic-integral implementation)

skrf.about: scikit-rf 2.1.0 media.MLine (hammerstadjensen, no dispersion) and media.CPW (Ghione, t = 0), 1 MHz, lossless: an independent BSD-3 implementation of the same papers

field.about: boarddd's own quasi-static field solver (src/impedance/fieldsolver.js, MIT): the field-sweep.json value where the sweep has the geometry, else solved on the sweep's grid (levels 2/3); cpwg with the sweep's via fence
